textos.Depende de como você ganha dinheiro na I: It depends on how you earn money in Ireland.
textos.O imposto já é descontado do salário. Me: Tax is already taken from your salary. Even so, it's worth filing the annual return in myAccount: that's where you add the credits and expenses that were left out and get back what you overpaid. You can review the last 4 years.
textos.Se você tem outra renda fora do emprego: If you have other income outside your job (rent, freelance work, interest): up to €5,000 net a year, and under €30,000 gross, it goes in your myAccount return. Above that, you file as a self-employed person.
textos.Quem trabalha por conta própria precisa: If you work for yourself, you must file a return every year (Form 11, through ROS, Revenue's online system).
textos.Junto com ela, você paga o imposto que f: Along with it, you pay the balance for the previous year and pay part of the current year in advance ("preliminary tax").
textos.Entregar a declaração do ano anterior e: File the previous year's return and pay the balance, plus preliminary tax for the current year.
textos.Quem entrega e paga tudo online pelo ROS: If you both file and pay online through ROS, you get a few extra days. In 2026 the deadline is 18 November. The date changes every year.
textos.Último dia para pedir de volta o ano mai: Last day to claim back the oldest year
textos.A restituição vale para os últimos 4 ano: Refunds cover the last 4 years. In 2026, it's the last day to claim for 2022.
textos.A declaração do ano que acabou fica disp: The return for the year just ended becomes available in myAccount, and you can claim back what you overpaid.
textos.Não precisa ter tudo na mão para entrar: You don't need everything to get in touch: I'll tell you what's missing for your case.
